scope: Actual frozen BaseItem.RefreshMetadata/Video.RefreshedOwnedItems, ordinary file resolution/coercion, LibraryManager.CreateItem/DeleteItem/fast wrong-type cleanup and ItemPersistenceService/EF SQLite over actual files. Records independent create/delete, cancellation and SQL boundaries, selected columns, complete stored Data, provider dispatch, cache and events. Single-item provider performs no save, collection membership, savers, media-source list and external-file dispatch are controls. Mixed owners skip FindExtras. No complete scanner, network, provider save or release acceptance.
candidateComparison: All 15 actual native recordings on real SQLite/PostgreSQL, including independent creation/deletion, coercion defaults, complete stored Data, file hashes, events, repeated live-entity dispatch and cancellation/SQL boundaries. Candidate media access uses Memory VFS with controlled creation time; instance state file cleanup is real. Read-only D3 destination previews are separate from the native mutation trace. Production host regressions cover creation before cancellation, live owner inheritance and writer preflight. Does not prove FindExtras, complete resolvers/scanner, general deletion, network/provider saves or release acceptance.
